id_and_class.summary: Steven Richheimer holds that consciousness is the fundamental ‘ground substance’ of reality, transformed first into a three-layered cosmic mind and then into the material world. Where planetary conditions allow, life arises and evolves to reflect the layers of cosmic mind, until sentient beings strive to complete the cycle by becoming one with Cosmic Consciousness. He argues that this top-down model explains quantum, relativistic, psi, and mystical phenomena better than materialism.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness as the Ground Substance of Creation

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is the primary substance from which cosmic mind and then matter are made. Cosmic Consciousness is both the source and the final goal of the creation cycle.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Matter is consciousness transformed through cosmic mind, so mind and matter are intrinsically linked within one reality. Richheimer cites the effect of mental states on physiology as a sign of this unity.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable (consciousness is the ground; matter derives from it, and individual minds reflect layers of cosmic mind)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Richheimer claims the model explains why we have a unified sense of self, with organisms increasingly reflecting the ‘I do’ and ‘I am’ layers of cosmic mind.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Cosmic Consciousness; cosmic mind with three layers (objective mind, I do, I am); a material world derived from them; a teleological creation cycle.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Inference to the best explanation, weighing how well spiritual and materialist models account for physics puzzles and anomalous experience, informed by long practice of tantric meditation.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: A cosmic cycle running from Cosmic Consciousness to cosmic mind (objective mind, I do, I am) to the material world, then back up through life and sentient beings who seek reunion with Cosmic Consciousness.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Cosmic consciousness; the unified self; the hard problem; psi, mystical, out-of-body, and near-death experiences.
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: A top-down transformation of consciousness into cosmic mind and then matter, the reverse of materialism's bottom-up account.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Consciousness descends into matter, then life and mind ascend as organisms evolve to reflect cosmic mind's layers more fully, ending in conscious reunion with the source.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Ubiquitous; consciousness is the substance of everything, with the observed ‘parts’ of the world emerging from a hidden transcendent reality.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Consciousness is the creative cause of the physical world and drives evolution toward sentient beings who seek their source.
mechanism_and_dynamics.evolutionary_account: Evolution appears teleological because it is: complex life arises from nonliving matter and develops toward sentient beings who strive to become one with Cosmic Consciousness.
core_claims_and_evidence: A consciousness-first model explains quantum nonlocality and entanglement and why observers seem to take part in how reality emerges.
It also explains features of relativity, such as the light-speed limit and the apparent illusoriness of time's flow.
It accounts for psi, reincarnation memories, and mystical, out-of-body, and near-death experiences, which Richheimer says materialism ignores.
Weighed by their credences, the spiritual model is a better model of reality than materialism.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Inference to the best explanation from physics and anomalous experience, plus personal meditative and spiritual practice.

empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: Richheimer openly begins by assuming the spiritual worldview is correct and then shows what it can explain, which invites the charge of circular reasoning that he says he tries to avoid. His evidence base leans on contested phenomena such as psi and reincarnation memories.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: The specific steps by which consciousness becomes cosmic mind and then matter, and how the model makes predictions beyond accommodating known puzzles, are not spelled out.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Consistent as a monistic spiritual idealism that keeps the material world real as a transformation of consciousness.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Richheimer treats reincarnation memories and near-death experiences as phenomena the model explains, and consciousness does not depend on the body.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: The universe has inherent meaning and purpose, rooted in sentient beings' drive to reunite with Cosmic Consciousness.

related_theories.name: Near Death Experiences, Survival, Past Lives

sources_and_references.title_with_names: The Logic of the Spiritual Worldview: How the Idea that Consciousness is the Ground Substance of Creation Explains just about Everything, Steven L. Richheimer
